title: Fractions on a Number Line Worksheets
intro: Teach fractions on a number line by identifying the unit interval first.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Mark zero and one, then count the equal spaces between them. Have the student count intervals to the marked point.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Ask your student

Are we counting tick marks or the spaces between them?

If your student needs help

If the denominator is one too large, trace each interval rather than counting the endpoints.
